# stripe-mcp

> FastMCP 3.4+ server for Stripe payment gateway, subscription analytics, billing support, and Austrian/EU tax compliance.

## Tools Summary
- `manage_stripe_customers`: Customer CRUD and search.
- `manage_stripe_subscriptions`: Active subscriber management, cancellations, pauses.
- `manage_stripe_payments`: Charges, payment intents, refunds, and dispute handling.
- `manage_stripe_checkout`: Payment links, Checkout Sessions (EPS, SEPA, PSD2 3DS2), and Invoices.
- `stripe_revenue_analytics`: MRR, churn rate, subscription KPIs, and Austrian VAT summaries.
- `calculate_austrian_vat`: Austrian VAT (20%, 10%, 13%) and ATU VAT ID validation.

## Endpoints
- REST Health: `http://127.0.0.1:11165/api/health`
- Webhooks: `http://127.0.0.1:11165/api/webhooks/stripe`
- MCP HTTP: `http://127.0.0.1:11165/mcp`
- Webapp: `http://127.0.0.1:11166`
